name: Outreach Agent
description: A human-in-the-loop prospecting engine for an independent engineering practice. Scheduled workers find AI-automation agencies whose hiring and delivery signals show a capacity gap, Claude scores each one against a contact gate and drafts a personalised first touch, and every draft lands in an approval queue as a Gmail draft. Nothing sends on its own: the operator approves and presses Send, while follow-ups, reply classification and suggested responses keep the conversation moving.

name: TrimFitt
description: The patient portal for TrimFitt, a physician-led telehealth practice offering GLP-1 weight loss, ketamine therapy, NAD+ and longevity protocols. New patients share their goals and health details and complete a screening in about three minutes, then create a secure account to manage follow-ups with their provider, refills and tracking for medication shipped to their home. HIPAA compliant.

name: Entrecore
description: An enterprise context layer that sits underneath the AI a business already uses. Entrecore learns what the company means by customer, revenue and churn, reconciles those definitions across finance, sales and product data, and traces every answer back to its source, so AI output is consistent and auditable instead of confidently wrong.

name: Construction Check
description: An enterprise operations platform for professional construction cost estimating. It gives estimating firms, A/E practices, owners, government and independent estimators a client hub for intake, scoping and delivery, a practice platform for team workflows and quality control, and Agent Louie, an AI assistant that learns from every estimate to surface comps and market insights.

name: Ampli-fi
description: An equipment sales and financing platform for equipment sellers, finance brokers and lenders. Salespeople build quotes with monthly payment options on the spot, buyers complete a digital credit application, and Ampli-fi runs automated credit checks and routes the deal to a lender marketplace, resubmitting to other lenders on a decline without new paperwork. Includes a Section 179 tax savings calculator.

name: UrGadget
description: Device inventory for electronics shops. Staff scan a barcode or type the IMEI to record a gadget in about 20 seconds, inspect and grade it, then sell it with an immutable receipt. Every device gets a passport of its full history, duplicates are blocked by IMEI or serial, and it works offline. Piloting with shops in Lagos and Abuja.

name: Inboxd
description: A pay-per-reply platform connecting fans with creators. Fans pay a creator's set price to send a message and get a guaranteed reply within the deadline, or an automatic full refund. Creators keep 85% of every message with payouts within 24 hours, while Inboxd handles Stripe payments, refunds and reminders.

name: Invoyce
description: A smart invoicing solution built for Africa's growing freelance community. Our platform helps freelancers create professional invoices, streamline payment collection, and maintain clear payment records. Designed with simplicity in mind, Invoyce makes financial management effortless for freelancers across Africa and beyond.

name: SnapBounty
description: A decentralized Web3 marketplace platform powered by Base blockchain. Users can discover and complete bounties, share content, and earn rewards through secure on-chain transactions.

name: Solxlog
description: A blockchain transaction logging and monitoring platform for Solana. Track, analyze, and visualize on-chain activities with real-time data and intuitive insights.

name: Envsane
description: A lightweight CLI tool for validating and comparing environment files. Catch missing variables, empty values, case mismatches, and duplicates before deployment. Configuration-free and language-agnostic.

name: Dotzee
description: Intuitive State Management for React. A Pinia-inspired state management solution combining Vue's reactivity system with React's component model for intuitive, type-safe state management.

name: Seams & Status
description: A smart invoicing solution built for Africa's growing freelance community. Our platform helps freelancers create professional invoices, streamline payment collection, and maintain clear payment records. Designed with simplicity in mind, Invoyce makes financial management effortless for freelancers across Africa and beyond.

name: GasTracka
description: A Progressive Web App that allows users to track their gas prices for various major blockchains.

name: ResuMate
description: A comprehensive resume templating web application that empowers users to create polished and professional resumes effortlessly.

name: GreenGrow
description: Smart Farming Solutions for a Sustainable Future. Revolutionize your agricultural practices with IoT sensors and data analytics that increase yields while reducing resource consumption.

name: ShopWithSteeze
description: Shop with Steeze, where sophistication meets style. Discover our exquisite collection of men's jewelry, meticulously crafted to elevate your everyday look.

name: 10k MRR
description: A one-page dashboard for a SaaS product that allows showcase their product and track their revenue, customers, and other metrics.

name: Trivia
description: A simple quiz app with varieties of sections including politics, geography, arts, philosophy etc.

name: Tenzie
description: A tenzie web based browser game built to practice basic react state. Players roll the dice until its all the same number on all available dies. Best time and no. of rolls are saved to local storage.

name: BookWormz
description: An open book library where users can search for books, read books, download and download them.

name: Movie Pitch
description: A simple AI web app done with openaiAPI. Users would input a single sentence for a movie and they would get back a movie title, synopsis, actors and even a poster.
